verdict: Lululemon's revenue rose 4% to $2.5B as China Mainland grew 30%, but profit fell 38% to $195M as the Americas shrank and gross margin dropped 410 points — and management cut the full-year outlook.

segments.name: Americas
segments.note: The engine market shrank: revenue fell 3% and comparable sales fell 5% (U.S. and Canada both down). Two of every three dollars still come from here.

segments.name: China Mainland
segments.note: Revenue jumped 30% as reported (23% in constant currency) and comparable sales rose 20% — about 8 points of the growth came from a Chinese New Year timing shift.

segments.name: Rest of World
segments.note: Europe, Asia-Pacific outside mainland China and elsewhere: revenue up 13% as reported, comparable sales up 5%.

flow.costPlain: Making and shipping the clothes — this quarter tariffs and markdowns pushed it up much faster than sales.

opex.name: Selling, general and administrative
opex.note: Store payroll, marketing and head-office costs — 42.9% of revenue, up from 39.8% a year ago.

opex.name: Amortization of intangible assets
opex.note: Spreading the cost of acquired intangible assets.

follow100Note: By channel: stores brought in $48.26 of every $100, e-commerce $40.35 and other channels $11.38. Rows may not add exactly due to rounding.

takeaways.title: The home market kept shrinking
takeaways.text: Americas comparable sales fell 5% and regional revenue fell 3% to $1,621M. China Mainland grew 30% to $478M and Rest of World 13% to $372M, which is the only reason total revenue grew at all.

takeaways.title: Margin fell 410 points
takeaways.text: Gross margin dropped to 54.2% from 58.3% on higher tariffs and heavier markdowns, while SG&A rose to 42.9% of revenue. Operating margin nearly halved to 11.2% from 18.5%.

takeaways.title: The full-year outlook was cut
takeaways.text: Management cut fiscal 2026 guidance to revenue of $11.000–11.150B (down 1% to flat) and EPS of $10.95–$11.15, down from $11.35–11.50B and $12.10–$12.30 guided in March.

oneTimers: Lululemon repurchased 2.2 million of its shares for $358.3M in the quarter and opened five net new company-operated stores, ending the quarter with 816 stores and $1.5B of cash.
otherDetail: Other income, net, was $9.1M, down from $11.8M a year ago.
footerNote: The release gives only percentage changes by region; the dollar splits are from Lululemon's Q1 fiscal 2026 Form 10-Q. Lululemon calls this fiscal year '2026' — it ends January 31, 2027.
